title: Biocarbon Fund
definition: The BioCarbon Fund (BioCF) is a public-private initiative managed by the World Bank that mobilizes finance for projects that sequester or conserve carbon in forest and agricultural ecosystems (Land Use, Land-Use Change, and Forestry - LULUCF).
importanceInUpsc: It is a critical component of Climate Finance and Sustainable Development, frequently linked to REDD+ mechanisms, sustainable agriculture, and international climate negotiations (UNFCCC).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Biocarbon Fund.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
